title: agropyron subulatum
intro: Agropyron subulatum, commonly known as Elymus subulatus, is a type of grass found in mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It is a perennial grass with a slender stem and narrow leaves, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Agropyron subulatum include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
